data.one_liner: Lightweight parser that flattens and builds JSON:API structures.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to decode JSON:API responses into plain JSON maps and encode plain JSON maps back into JSON:API format. Handles relationships, meta, links and supports null attributes.
use_when: You need to integrate a JSON:API backend without adding heavy dependencies
You want a simple way to convert between JSON:API and flat JSON for use with json_serializable
avoid_when: You require full JSON:API client features like networking or pagination handling
You need code generation for model classes
strengths: Zero Flutter dependency, works on all Dart platforms
Handles complex relationships and meta data
weaknesses: Only handles encoding/decoding, no networking utilities
